`python3 roster.py inactive` now lists learners whose last login was 14 or more days ago. Against the current data it returns two:

```
L-004  Dara Novak           dara@example.org         2026-08-11  54d
L-002  Ben Whitlock         ben.w@example.org        2026-09-02  32d
```

Each row shows id, name, email, last login date and days since. The longest-inactive learners come first, unlike `list` and `course`, which sort by name.

The 14-day threshold is the `INACTIVE_AFTER_DAYS` constant at the top of `roster.py`. I also added the command to the usage text and the README.
